rationale: Settings retained at conservative defaults to ensure robustness given the absence of explicit management treatments (fertilizer, irrigation, cultivar). The water_proxy shift fraction is capped at 0.5 to prevent unrealistic counterfactuals derived solely from weather/soil data. Feature limits (5) and stress thresholds (0.75) align with the dataset's feature distribution, prioritizing temperature and water hazards while excluding non-existent management variables.
